t: Wiping with the right hand while saying it
a: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ اشْفِهِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
p: Adhhibi-l-ba'sa Rabba-n-nās, ishfihi anta-sh-Shāfī, lā shifā'a illā shifā'uk, shifā'an lā yughādiru saqamā.
m: Remove the harm, Lord of the people. Cure him, You are the Curer. There is no cure except Your cure, a cure that leaves no illness behind.
